purpose: Transform E2 exploratory heuristic signal into objective confirmatory evidence of node-level model specialization
current_30_tasks_status: PERMANENTLY_SEALED - Cannot be used for E2.1 threshold tuning, task selection, or model ranking

tasks.power_precision_requirement: Must confirm sample size provides adequate power for minimum effect size BEFORE any model calls
tasks.power_analysis_method: Pre-execution paired bootstrap power calculation using minimum effect size, NOT based on +0.117 exploratory heuristic
tasks.adjustment_rule: If 60 tasks insufficient for target power (≥0.8), increase to 80 or 100 BEFORE model execution. No post-hoc sample size increases.
tasks.selection_criteria: Outcome-blind based on observable complexity: context length, evidence span, table/text structure, cross-page requirements, cross-section requirements
tasks.diversity_requirement: Balanced distribution across sources and complexity levels

evidence_ids: string IDs in format: docX_pY_sZ, tableA_rB_cC

primary_node.prohibited_output: Free-form text explanation, evidence descriptions, reasoning chains
primary_node.rationale: Measure evidence ID retrieval capability, NOT language generation quality or style

gold_annotation.evidence_id_format: Standardized format: docX_pY_sZ for text, tableA_rB_cC for tabular

quality_control.adjudication: Tasks below threshold go to third senior annotator

scoring_system.predicted_set: Set of evidence IDs output by model
scoring_system.gold_sets: Union of gold_evidence_set and all acceptable_alternative_sets

calculation.f1: 2 × Precision × Recall / (Precision + Recall) if (Precision + Recall) > 0 else 0
calculation.task_quality: max over all acceptable gold sets of F1(Predicted, GoldSet)

tie_handling.winner_selection: No winner assigned for ties, recorded as tie in margin analysis

primary_endpoint.statistical_requirement: Task-level bootstrap 95% CI must show positive headroom

held_out_reversal_rate.role: Stability diagnostic, REPORT ONLY, no 'higher is better' gate

repeat_protocol.final_metrics: Average across all three rotation schemes
repeat_protocol.rationale: Prevents bias from any single repeat being 'special'

success_criteria.fail_action: STOP N1 hypothesis, conclude exploratory signal was heuristic-driven

e2_1_b_protocol.purpose: End-to-end causal validation of N1 specialist value

experimental_design.type: Controlled variable experiment - only N1 model varies
experimental_design.tasks: 30-task deterministically selected subset from E2.1-A (hash-based, pre-frozen)
experimental_design.selection_rule: Fixed BEFORE seeing any E2.1-A model results

arm_d.name: Gold Evidence @ N1
arm_d.n1_input: Human gold evidence IDs (no model call)

frozen_settings.seed: Fixed if provider supports deterministic generation

downstream_control.rationale: Isolate causal effect of N1 model selection, minimize downstream sampling noise

api_calls.estimated_cost: $4-6 (accounting for both evidence retrieval and downstream generation)

theoretical_ceiling.interpretation: Maximum possible improvement from perfect N1

statistical_analysis.primary_question: Does ΔQ_final > 0 with 95% CI not including 0?
statistical_analysis.secondary_question: What fraction of tasks show positive delta?

success_criteria.primary: Mean ΔQ_final > 0 with 95% CI not including 0
success_criteria.ceiling_check: Gold@N1 shows meaningful improvement (confirms N1 is bottleneck)
success_criteria.cost_benefit: Quality gain justified by computational cost increase
success_criteria.fail_action: Specialization exists but lacks end-to-end system value

outcome_a_full_support.interpretation: Node specialization exists AND provides end-to-end value
outcome_a_full_support.action: Proceed to E2.2 Router training with high confidence

outcome_b_node_only.interpretation: Specialization exists but final quality gain not established
outcome_b_node_only.action: Investigate bottleneck transmission, do not train full router

outcome_c_no_confirmation.action: STOP N1 hypothesis, exploratory signal was heuristic-driven

prohibited_actions.current_30_task_reuse: Forbidden for E2.1 threshold tuning, task selection, or model comparison
prohibited_actions.router_training: Forbidden until both E2.1-A and E2.1-B PASS
prohibited_actions.post_hoc_threshold_adjustment: Forbidden after seeing any model results

documentation_requirements.pre_registration: All analysis plans and success criteria fixed before execution
documentation_requirements.sha256_archival: Protocol and all modifications archived with SHA256 checksums
documentation_requirements.transparency: All limitations and methodological constraints explicitly reported
documentation_requirements.reproducibility: Complete code and data pipeline version-controlled

scientific_contribution.intended_contribution: We establish a controlled decomposition-to-routing causal chain in complex financial reasoning
scientific_contribution.focus: Methodological rigor and objective validation of decomposition-exposed specialization
